items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: I know Johnny Otis told me that she lived there

ctx.x: He sees her at times I think. I know Johnny Otis told me that she lived there and he didn't know who she was. And one day he saw Jo. He said, for goodness sakes. What about poor Cozy (Cole)?
He was one of the great ones.
